units.summary: Adds a setter that appends the from-selected-series hint idempotently and keeps hints sorted. Mirrors SetStaleSeries; persisted in meta.json.

units.summary: Write now propagates the selected-series hint from base meta to the new block, like stale-series. Affects how compacted blocks are tagged and thus excluded from inOrderBlocksMaxTime.
units.headline: Compactor Write propagates selected-series hint from base
units.reason: Changes persisted block metadata for compacted blocks.
focus: Whether propagating the hint to the Write base is desired for all callers

focus: Callers of inOrderBlocksMaxTime that decide OOO handling
Whether excluding these blocks can regress the watermark after restart
